title: supermarket/promotions
description: One row per promotional offer on one product. Time-limited offers. A promotion covers a single product over a date range, so checking whether a given sale was discounted means comparing the transaction date against this table.

product_id.description: The product on offer. A product can have several promotions over time, but they never overlap.

type.description: Mechanic of the offer: a straight percentage off, second unit at half price, three for the price of two, or a fixed cash reduction.

discount_percent.description: Headline reduction as a percentage, between 5 and 50. For non-percentage mechanics this records the effective equivalent saving.

starts_on.description: First day the offer is live, inclusive. Compare a sale date against this and ends_on to decide whether a line was discounted.

ends_on.description: Last day the offer is live, inclusive. Always after starts_on, typically by one to six weeks.
